title: How to count days since a date
task: Age of a ticket, order, or item — how long ago something happened.

excel.note: A2 = the past date. Format the result as a Number.

explanation: Today minus the past date gives elapsed days directly — July 1 to July 26 is 25 days (the verification pins both ends; use TODAY() live and the count grows daily). If the answer displays as a date like "1/25/1900", switch the cell format to Number. Common companions: bucket the ages with the closest-match lookup recipe (0-30/31-60/61-90 aging), and NETWORKDAYS(A2,TODAY()) counts only business days elapsed.
